title: McpEvidenceContext
description: The resolved point-in-time context of one MCP response (design contract §6.3): cutoff, timestamp mode, corpus/index/parser/verifier pins, the selected document version where one applies, and frozen cursor filters. The context and evidence replay byte-identically when the caller supplies effective_as_of and applicable pins. The only exemptions are live_status and expiring cursor token bytes, not context, evidence, ordering or page boundaries.

temporal_guarantee.description: strict under timestamp_mode strict; none under approximate, whose results are excluded from temporal acceptance evidence.

index_version_id.description: The resolved index used by search_filings. Null for tools that do not use an index, independent of index publication or rebuild. get_corpus_status validates and echoes an explicitly supplied available index pin; omitted stays null. Unknown, unpublished, retired or incompatible explicit pins return pin_unavailable, never a fallback.

parser_version.description: Parser version of the selected document version; null when the response spans several document versions (each Citation carries its own).

verifier_version.description: Fixed deterministic-v1 for every non-verification tool. verify_claim resolves its requested verifier pin, or deterministic-v1 when omitted; unavailable pins return pin_unavailable, never a fallback or latest verifier.

document_version_id.description: The selected document version where one applies, else null.

filters.description: Filters frozen into this context's cursors. A cursor used with different filters returns invalid_input.
